scope: Reviewed private source refresh and immutable report versions

browser.flow: Review form -> private job -> fixture source/model -> new version -> logout/login/reopen

guardrails: Verified owner/admin/editor and explicit scope review
Stable nonce job ID and audit replay tombstone after job expiry
Three new refreshes per business/hour; replay and concurrent submit reuse one job
Fresh access checks before/after async work and at publication
Private hidden checkpoint, no anonymous report claim token
Original JSON/export unchanged; new immutable version/history
Permission revocation and source denial never fabricate a version
Account removal clears queued/running ciphertext; expiry removes unpublished checkpoints
Owner-provided descriptions/uploads cannot become crawl targets
